name: Roger W. Crandall

career.title: Investment Management Department (rising to Managing Director)

career.organization: Babson Capital Management (David L. Babson & Company)
career.title: Managing Director; head of Corporate Bond Management, Public Bond Trading and Institutional Fixed Income
Executive Vice President and Chief Investment Officer of MassMutual; Chairman of Babson Capital

background_rationale: Spent nearly two decades in MassMutual's investment management and fixed-income businesses, including running bond trading at Babson Capital and serving as Chief Investment Officer, before moving into operating leadership.

notable.summary: MassMutual converted its 125,000 preferred shares of Jefferies Financial Group into about 4.65 million common shares, which Crandall said built on a long-term relationship with the firm.
MassMutual closed the sale of an 18% stake in its asset manager Barings to Japan's MS&AD Insurance Group, keeping 82% and controlling governance rights.
MassMutual agreed to reinsure a block of universal life policies with secondary guarantees, with nearly $6 billion in statutory reserves, with Nationwide; the deal closed in June 2026.

Marking MassMutual's 175th anniversary, Crandall said the milestone was about the people who rely on the company and the commitments it has kept, as it paid an estimated record $2.9 billion in 2026 policyowner dividends.

personal_story.hook: Roger Crandall joined MassMutual's investment department in 1988 and has run the 175-year-old insurer since 2010.
personal_story.summary: Crandall earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the University of Vermont and an MBA from the Wharton School, and is a Chartered Financial Analyst. He joined MassMutual in 1988 and spent 12 years in its investment management department, then moved to its Babson Capital subsidiary, where he ran corporate bond management and public bond trading. He became MassMutual's Chief Investment Officer and Babson's chairman in 2005, co-COO in 2007 and President and COO in December 2008, and succeeded Stuart Reese as CEO on January 1, 2010. Outside MassMutual he has chaired the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston's board and in 2026 joined Constellation Energy's board.
